title: A Clarifying Note on the Position-Momentum Correspondence: Pontryagin Duality, Fourier Transport, and Physical Normalization
summary: The position--momentum correspondence combines several mathematically distinct identifications that are often conflated. For the additive group $(\mathbb R,+)$, every continuous character has the form $x\mapsto \mathrm e^{ikx}$. After choosing a coordinate $p=αk$ on the dual group, one obtains $\mathrm e^{ipx/α}$, so Pontryagin duality alone does not identify a particular dual coordinate with physical momentum.
